title: Our ComfyUI must not share port 8188 with the user's own ComfyUI
description: A user running his own ComfyUI on the default 8188 had every generation die with "Node 'Input_Seed' not found" - the app dispatched into HIS ComfyUI, which has no MpiNodes. Move our engine to 48188 and refuse to dispatch at an engine we did not start.
